about_the_game:
Story

You are left all alone in the world after losing your last remaining relative, with only the apartment inherited from your late father.

Suddenly, a man appears and gives you - the new landlord - a warning.

"There are Yokai living among the residents in your apartment building."

Your time spent sleuthing out the cleverly disguised Yokai began from that moment.

Overview

”Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!”

In this social deduction adventure game, the player uses the information they gather to find the Yokai who have attempted to blend in with the residents of the apartment building you manage.

This work is a single story composed of multiple chapters, and as you move on to the next chapter, the seasons change and new residents and yokai move in to make up for the absence of the last evicted yokai.

Each chapter requires the residents to deduce who the yokai is that are mixed in with the residents, provide evidence, and evcict him or her.

The overall theme of the game is to find out why yokai is infiltrating the protagonist's apartment and what the intentions of the mysterious man who tells him about them are.

Gameplay

Gather information from the residents to uncover the Yokai who are hiding among your apartment's residents.

The residents will come to the player, as the new landlord, with complaints and requests, or just to have a chat.

This will give you the information you need to root out all of the Yokai.

If you notice anything in their conversations that feels out of place, that may be a clue to the Yokai's identity. Note down anything important that you hear.

Check the apartment's security cameras (Appears in Chapter Two)

Yokai are cunning. Even with security cameras installed, that doesn't mean they will reveal themselves so easily.

But you might be able to catch them dong something that's not quite human-like when they think no one's looking, or something they normally wouldn't do when in their human forms.

Behavior that appears ordinary at first glance could be a hint. Keep no stone unturned, and root out the Yokai.

Evict the Yokai upon discovery

Evict the resident after you have gathered enough evidence and identified them as a Yokai.

But be careful, if you mistake a real human for a Yokai and evict them, the remaining residents will become even more suspicious of each other, which is exactly what the Yokai want.

Stay calm during your investigations and keep the residents safe until the day of the new moon, when the Yokai will reveal their true forms.

If you don't evict them in time...

On the night of the new moon, the Yokai will display their true power.

When that happens, there will be nothing that we powerless humans can do.

Not just a mystery adventure! A heart-warming tale of character growth awaits you.

Streaming Guidelines

For streamers, streaming guideliness are posted on the official website.

Please take a look.

For those playing on Steam Deck

Please run through Compatibility - Proton.
